name: tippin-portal-demo-video
description: A vertical motion graphics demo of the Tippin' Cowgirl site and staff portal, made with Remotion. Separate from the app: nothing here ships with the site.

scripts.studio: node scripts/fetch-fonts.mjs && node scripts/prepare-ad.mjs && remotion studio src/index.ts
scripts.render: node scripts/fetch-fonts.mjs && remotion render src/index.ts TippinPortalDemo out/tippin-portal-demo.mp4
scripts.render:ad: node scripts/fetch-fonts.mjs && node scripts/prepare-ad.mjs && remotion render src/index.ts TippinAd30 out/tippin-ad-30s.mp4
scripts.render:ad15: node scripts/fetch-fonts.mjs && node scripts/prepare-ad.mjs && remotion render src/index.ts TippinAd15 out/tippin-ad-15s.mp4
scripts.render:ad45: node scripts/fetch-fonts.mjs && node scripts/prepare-ad.mjs && remotion render src/index.ts TippinAd45 out/tippin-ad-30s-4x5.mp4
scripts.textures: remotion still src/index.ts AdTextureLeather public/textures/leather.jpg --image-format=jpeg --jpeg-quality=88 && remotion still src/index.ts AdTextureGrain public/textures/grain.png --image-format=png
